summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a local-market bond placement. The bank placed Serie FG senior dematerialized bearer bonds (UF 250,000, maturing November 1, 2030) at an average rate of 2.74%. The filing is a routine debt issuance notification to the Chilean regulator and stock exchanges. No special-situation catalyst such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. This is ordinary course financing activity with no deal terms, premium, or shareholder vote. No risk-arb angle applies.
